Sam is a very tall and lank youth. He has distinct tow-colored hair.

## History

Sam worked as a hired boy for a neighbor living near [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside). While [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was boarding with Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet, he paid an awkward visit to her accommodation. Sam later made an awkward marriage proposal to [Anne](../character/anne.md), which she politely rejected.
